# MITRE ATT&CK

ATT&CK is a knowledge base of adversary **tactics**, **techniques**, and **procedures** observed in the wild. Umbra wiki imports map technique IDs (e.g. `T1557.002`) to pages and link them from concept articles.

Attribution to threat groups must remain careful and sourced — imported group pages carry MITRE’s descriptions, not Umbra original claims.
